title: Affine pushforward normalization on identity representatives
statement: For commutative rings A and B, a ring map phi : B → A, an integer i, and the shared derived-category instances, there is a natural isomorphism from T_B res_phi Gamma_A H^i to H^i Rf_* on D_QCoh(Spec A), with f = Spec(phi), satisfying q_C = T_B res_phi b_(C,id) followed by d at Q(T_A C). Equivalently it satisfies the normalization equation whenever the representative isomorphism is eqToHom of an object equality. T, q and b are the concrete tilde, derived-unit and cohomology-coordinate maps of the parent module; their definition dependencies are listed in stmt_deps. Only identity representatives, not arbitrary automorphisms, are asserted.

proof.text: For f affine, higher direct images of every quasi-coherent module vanish. Apply the unbounded acyclic derived pushforward cohomology comparison with bound one on each inverse image of an affine open. Use the comparison induced by the right-derived unit, computed by a K-injective resolution and the truncation argument of 08D4, rather than an arbitrary choice of the existence-only isomorphism. This gives H^i(Rf*L) naturally isomorphic to f*H^i(L).

The affine tilde/Gamma counit and the natural identity-on-sections pushforward/restriction comparison identify f*H^i(L) with T_B res_phi Gamma_A H^i(L). Compose the inverse of the preceding normalized cohomology comparison to obtain d. Exact tilde and exact restriction of scalars give q_C as specified. The tilde adjunction triangle identity identifies its termwise comparison with the same ordinary-to-derived unit. Thus q_C equals T_B res_phi b_(C,id) followed by d at Q(T_A C).
For a representative whose hom is eqToHom h, eliminate h; uniqueness of inverses identifies the representative isomorphism with Iso.refl. Apply the identity calculation.

theorem affineTildePushforwardCohomologyNormalization_base
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : B →+* A) (i : ℤ) :
    ∃ d : affineDerivedCohomologyModules A i ⋙
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ ⋙ affineTildeFunctor B) ≅
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ⋙
          schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i,
      ∀ C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ,
        affineTildePushforwardIdentityNormalization A B φ i d C
